ValidationRule.description: R-GR4: once its batch is posted, a line is the link between the deposit slip and a gift, so it is not added or changed. The platform clearing Gift when that gift is deleted is allowed.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Gift_Batch__r.Status__c, "Posted"), OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Donor_Contact__c), ISCHANGED(Donor_Account__c), ISCHANGED(Amount__c), ISCHANGED(Gift_Date__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Method__c), ISCHANGED(Payment_Reference__c), ISCHANGED(Fund__c), ISCHANGED(Appeal__c), AND(ISCHANGED(Gift__c), NOT(ISBLANK(Gift__c))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This batch has been posted, so its lines can no longer be added or changed. To correct a gift, refund or write off that gift.
